name: Apple Jelly
subtitle: Clear, bright fruit jelly from whole chopped apples
description: Cook chopped apples with lemon, strain the fruit to collect the juice, then boil it with sugar until it reaches a jelly set.

ingredients.item: apples washed well and roughly chopped (skin and core kept on)

instructions.text: Place the chopped apples and lemon in a large pan with enough water to cover, then bring to a boil.
Cook the apples gently for 40 minutes, or until completely soft and pulpy.
Strain the cooked fruit through a jelly bag or fine sieve without pressing, collecting the juice in a clean pan.
Measure the juice and add the jam sugar according to the extracted amount, stirring until dissolved.
Bring the mixture to a full boil and cook for 10 minutes, or until it reaches a jelly set.
Pour the hot jelly into the jars and leave it undisturbed until set.
